items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yeah, the other guitar player. So, anyways, this particular night, Tony Bennet comes in with Carter and they come to see the group wherever we play. Tony Bennet would always hire, even in Vegas, he would always hire Harold Land, or guys he grew up with in the orchestra. He loves Harold Land and Clifford Brown. So this guy…(Laughs) we are over at Charlie Birds and he comes with an entourage. He brought everybody in Washington to the club. I said, “Benny, might have a guest tonight. I saw Bull Moose.” He said,…

We’re back to Benny Golson—and I want to come back to Wayne State and Joe Henderson, but, since we are on Benny Golson, talk about your Washington connection. You played in this club, you’re here this weekend. But, you were here when the Bohemian Caverns actually became the legendary place it was in the 60’s.
